assumptions: Within each campaign and phase, paired effects are independent draws from a distribution with a common median
Repeated method-order schedules do not establish independence or rule out serial, cache, order or system effects
Pointwise paired-median intervals do not estimate the ratio of marginal medians
Precision floors are representation margins, not guaranteed measurement-error bounds

existing_variation_screen.scope: Descriptive variation screen, not the confidence acceptance rule

fixture.allocation_scope: sum of st_blocks * 512, including hardlink aliases; not exclusive physical storage

measurement.precision: Original per-row precision_floor values retained without rounding; absent source fields remain absent
measurement.resources: Separate /usr/bin/time -lp command wrapper; peak individual-child RSS
measurement.rss_scope: Measured process peak, not whole-system, FSKit-service, kernel or cache memory
measurement.sharing_scope: Data-bearing regular-file streams; no resource-fork or exclusive disk-space savings claim
measurement.timing: Direct command elapsed and child CPU accounting
